reviewMethod: All 337 steps in all 78 lessons of the five follow-up groups checked in four disjoint local browser runs with real audio. Explicit coverage comparison prevents missing or duplicate lessons. Manual continuation, every source letter group, repeated letters, eight-slot words, matching demos, wrong choices, Kijk nog eens, resume, forward jumps, within-group continuation and all five group endings were exercised. Guided active slots and buttons fit together on small screens; layout checked at 320/390/1366 pixels. Dictation and recall do not reveal model letters. All existing components, layout, media, article labels, routes and storage are byte-unchanged. Preparation is outside this extension. 42 representative steps from sjaal/taxi passed again.
limitations: Browser emulation, no physical phone or learner pilot.
Existing content and pronunciation review limits retained. No new audio, content or media bindings.
